French Presidential Candidates Debate Economic Issues

Seven candidates for the French presidency participated in their first debate, eight months before the election. They reached a consensus on the existence of economic difficulties in France but presented divergent solutions. The debate also touched upon the legacy of President Macron, with centrist candidates navigating criticism of his governance style while seeking to retain his voter base.
